d: Short, sleek midnight-purple hair with straight-cut bangs and a side parting. Sharp, narrow violet eyes with a confident expression on a youthful face. A slender, curvaceous build wearing a black sleeveless mini-dress with criss-cross brown detailing on the chest, paired with sheer black thigh-high stockings and black high-heeled pumps. A voluminous, fluffy crimson-red faux fur coat is draped over the shoulders, accented by gold hoop earrings, a gold bracelet, and a black wristband.
